user.title: Select FSL Gateway
user.description: Choose a discovered FSL gateway on your local network or enter its connection details manually.

manual.title: Connect to FSL Gateway
manual.description: Enter the local IP address and UDP port of your FSL gateway.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure FSL Gateway
reconfigure.description: Update the local connection details for your FSL gateway.

abort.unique_id_mismatch: The selected gateway MAC address does not match this entry.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the FSL gateway over UDP. Please check the IP address, port, and network.
error.invalid_mac: Invalid MAC address format. Use 6 hex bytes such as 02:00:00:00:00:54.

reload_devices.name: Reload devices
reload_devices.description: Re-fetch the FSL gateway manifest (Type 5/6), synchronize rooms to Areas, and poll light statuses.

entry_id.name: Config entry
entry_id.description: Optional FSL gateway config entry to reload. Reloads all FSL entries when omitted.
